name: tinywarden-agent
usage:
Usage: tinywarden-agent --version | --help | enroll --config CONFIG_PATH --token-file TOKEN_PATH | replace --config CONFIG_PATH --token-file TOKEN_PATH | run --config CONFIG_PATH
Administrative commands (sudo): install, update, check, repair, reconnect, auto-updates on|off, --uninstall [--keep-data|--purge]. Use --install-dir for a custom managed location. Monitoring runs as the service account.
notReady: Choose enroll, replace or run. Use --help for the required options.
invalidArguments: Unsupported arguments. Use --help for available options.
enrolled: Enrollment confirmed. Start the agent to send heartbeats.
replaced: Credential replacement confirmed. Restart the agent to send heartbeats.
degraded: The server is unavailable. Retrying the saved request at a slower rate.
commandFailed: Agent stopped. Check its configuration, private state and server availability.

setup.stdinHelp: read the setup code from standard input instead of prompting
setup.arguments: Use --setup-code-stdin only with install, without --setup-code-file or --adopt.
setup.pollHelp: check Fleet update requests and run scheduled automatic work when due
setup.pollArguments: Use --poll only with update, without automatic, setup, archive or removal options.

reconnect.scopeMismatch: This setup code belongs to a different server or app.
reconnect.unfinished: Reconnection is unfinished. The service will resume its saved replacement request.
reconnect.completed: Server reconnected. The agent follows its current monitoring policy.
